description: This file contains internal classes implementing transaction management and resource control with fault injection capabilities for Orleans-based distributed systems. It defines classes for managing transaction lifecycle events, fault injection points, and resource operations, primarily for testing fault tolerance and recovery scenarios.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionManager`1
classes.description: Manages transaction lifecycle with fault injection points, allowing simulation of faults before and after key transaction phases.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalResource`1
classes.description: Wraps transactional resource operations with fault injection logic to simulate faults during resource operations such as prepare, confirm, abort, cancel, and read-only commit.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction, injecting faults if configured, and possibly deactivating the grain after the operation.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Marks a transaction as prepared, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Pings a transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Commits a read-only transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts a transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms a transaction, with fault injection and optional deactivation.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a transaction with fault injection, possibly injecting faults before or after the prepare phase.
